topics.definition: Wireless networks connect devices using radio waves instead of cables.
Wi-Fi standards define wireless communication technologies.
tips: Newer standards offer higher speed and efficiency.

topics.definition: Bluetooth enables short-range wireless communication between devices.
tips: Low power consumption for nearby devices.

topics.definition: Near Field Communication (NFC) enables very short-range wireless data exchange.
tips: Works only over a few centimeters.

topics.definition: Cellular networks provide wireless communication over large areas.
tips: 5G offers higher speed and lower latency.

topics.definition: An access point allows wireless devices to connect to a wired network.
tips: Place access points to maximize coverage.

topics.definition: Wireless security protects Wi-Fi networks using encryption and authentication.
tips: Use WPA3 when available and strong passwords.

topics.definition: Maintain secure, reliable and efficient wireless networks.
